name: Bunbun Slave
source:
In the world of the Lapis Garden, there's not enough men. So the Department of Fertility sends you out to go breed all the furry ladies. Good luck.


You play as Plum, a plucky young rabbit male, and your job, your sole responsibility in life is to impregnate women. It's a hard job, one that has it's ups and downs, and comes thrusting at you with surprises every turn, but it's your job.

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/bunbun-slave]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在青金石花园的世界里，男性数量不足。于是，生育部门派你去让所有兽人女性繁衍后代。祝你好运。

你将扮演普拉姆，一只精力充沛的年轻雄兔。你的工作，也是你人生中唯一的职责，就是让女性怀孕。这份工作很辛苦，有起有伏，每一个转角都会有意外迎面而来，但工作就是工作。

[摘自[url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/bunbun-slave]Itch.io[/url]]
